lawfulness_metrics.meaning: Normalized change between the final state and one more bundle step.
The induced core should have more than one effective package/state.
The induced return structure should involve multiple return lengths or packages.
At least three primitive families should contribute nontrivially to the generated substrate.
Fraction of changes attributable purely to P2-style gating without active P1/P3/P6 generation.

notes: This matrix resets the search space around bundle-generated substrates rather than imported theorem classes.
